verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS documents that streams are automatically ingested at a location near the broadcaster, runs on the global infrastructure that powers Twitch, and uses AWS regions (selected with a --region CLI flag). That covers the nearby point-of-presence half of the story, but the pack never lists the regions or describes the edge network that carries media. Missing for 10: documented list of regions/PoPs or edge network topology, evidence that viewers (not just broadcasters) connect to a nearby edge, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, clients connect to a nearby point of presence and the vendor documents the regions or edge network that carries media

citations.quote: When you stream, Amazon IVS automatically ingests video at a location near you.
Use the same live streaming technology and global infrastructure that powers Twitch.
